item.text: {"0":"Across all four datasets, replace only the existing projected frequency input with z_i=2*tanh(((log1p(f_i)-mu)/sigma)/2), using category-specific training-item counts and training-only mu,sigma; assign zero to padding and unseen items. Bounding extreme frequency features may reduce popularity-driven attention distortion while retaining frequency ordering. Keep inverse-frequency embedding scaling, learned embeddings, projection, HSTU topology, readout, loss and optimizer fixed. Persist the transformed feature buffer and restore it identically through the predictor writer, retaining one model/checkpoint per category."}
